decision_cruda.rationale: The radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 is down at TJ-C564-14 with a hydraulic failure (OT-5100, 3-5 h, likely 4 h), so no confirmation is needed. I recommend no loan, because Central's trucks are already the limit. Truck capacity is about 91 t/h (4 trucks x 40 t x 0.227, cycle about 0.4 h). Without LH-01, the two Central loaders still working (LH-02 at about 43 t/h and LH-03 at about 36 t/h) give about 79 t/h, plus a 171 t stockpile that is not drained by 17:00. Supply is about 737 t against about 700 t of truck capacity, so an extra loader adds almost no hauled ounces. The only candidate is LH-09, taken from DS-C564-02. That costs 1.5 oz/h x about 7 h, roughly 11 oz, plus about 0.34 h of travel, against a gain close to zero (a small grade benefit at best, since TJ-C564-14 is 12.1 g/t against the other Central stopes at 8.4-9.2 g/t). LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00 (PM-01), and LH-01 is likely back around 13:20, so a loan would overlap only about 1 h and gain about 2 oz at most. The reserve stopes need a loader from a stopped stope, and none is stopped. Net expected change is about 0 oz, so I keep everything as it is.
